protocol.minimum_tie_break: first ROC point; most restrictive acceptance threshold

limitations: No fresh-from-zero rebuild of every inherited package is claimed.
Full interface acceptance uses CPU; ONNX CUDA requires a separate profile.
Two Torch CUDA smoke tests do not establish all-model GPU parity.
Whisper fixture transcript is not matched ground truth; its WER is not a benchmark.
Only g17/g18/g19 cross-host execution is tested; other cluster machines are not implied.
System libraries, model assets and upstream sources are separate from pip requirements.
